spans.s:
चुर् चुर्, cl. 10. and (according to some)
1. P. चोरयति, अचूचुरत् &c., चोरति &c.,
to steal, rob; [cf. Gr. φωράω; Lat. furari; Hib.
coire, ‘trespass, offence,’ &c.]

चूर् चूर्, cl. 4. A. चूर्यते, चुचूरे, चूरितुम्,
to burn.
चुरण, अम्, n. stealing, thieving, robbing.
चुरण्य, nom. P. चुरण्यति, to thieve, steal, rob.
चुरा, f. stealing, theft; [cf. चौर.]
चुरी चुरी, f. a small well.

चूरी चूरी, f. (a various reading for चुरी), a
small well.
चूरिका, f. = चूरी, above.
चूरु चूरु, उस्, m. a kind of worm.

चूर्ण् चूर्ण् (perhaps more properly re-
garded as a nom. fr. चूर्ण below), cl. 10.
P. चूर्णयति, -यितुम्, to reduce to powder or flour,
to crumble, pulverize, grind, pound, knead, crush,
bruise, split, crumple; [cf. Hib. coirneach, ‘a part;’
crinim, ‘I gnaw, bite.’]

चूर्ण, अस्, अम्, m. n. (said to be connected in the
first instance with rt. चर्व्), powder, any minute
particle of substance; flour; aromatic powder, pulvil,
pounded sandal; pounded camphor; (अस्), m. chalk,
lime.
—चूर्ण-कार, अस्, m. a lime-burner, maker of
lime, considered as a man of mixed caste.
—चूर्ण-
कुन्तल, अस्, m. a lock of hair, a curl, curly hair.
—चूर्ण-खण्ड, अस्, अम्, m. n. a pebble, gravel,
hardened fragments of earth or brick; limestone
nodule, commonly known in India by the name of
Concar or कर्कर.
—चूर्ण-ता, f. or चूर्ण-त्व, अम्,
n. pulverulence, comminution, the state of dust or
powder.
—चूर्ण-पद, अम्, n. a peculiar exercise or
movement, walking backwards and forwards at various
paces.
—चूर्ण-पारद, अस्, m. vermilion.
—चूर्ण-
मुष्टि, इस्, f. a handful of powder or perfume.
—चूर्ण-योग, आस्, m. pl. a fragrant compound, per-
fumed powder: [cf. वास-योग.]
—चूर्ण-शस्, ind.
in powder, (ground) to powder (e. g. चूर्णशः कृ,
to reduce to powder).
—चूर्ण-शाकाङ्क (˚क-अङ्˚),
अस्, m. a kind of vegetable; [cf. गौर-सुवर्ण.]

चूर्णक, अस्, m. grain fried and pounded; a kind
of grain belonging to the class called Ṣaṣṭika;
(अम्), n. a fragrant powder; a kind of easy prose not
abounding in compound words; expounding in prose
the purport of a foregoing verse, giving the order or
interpretation of the words; [cf. चूर्णिका.]
चूर्णन, अम्, n. rubbing, pounding, pulverizing.

चूर्णि, इस्, f. (said by some to come fr. rt. चर्), a
sum of 100 kapardas or cowries, i. e. the small shell
Cypræa Moneta, used as a coin; (इस् or ई), f., N. of
Patañjali's great commentary or Mahā-bhāṣya, on the
Sūtras of Pāṇini, perhaps so named because Patañjali
notices every minute point of difficulty in Pāṇini's
grammar [cf. एक-चूर्णि]; a selection or picking out
of an unanswerable argument; (ई), f., N. of a river
near the Grāma Rāṇāghaṭṭa.
—चूर्णि-कृत्, त्, m. an
epithet of Patañjali, the author of the Mahā-bhāṣya;
an annotator, commentator in general.

चूर्णिका, f. fried and pounded rice, or grain of any
kind; a kind of cake; a sort of metre; a kind of
easy prose; [cf. चूर्णक.]

चूर्णित, अस्, आ, अम्, ground, pulverized, pounded,
reduced to dust or powder; bruised, smashed.

चूर्णिन्, ई, इनी, इ, made or mixed up with anything
powdered or pounded, covered with it.

चूर्णी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्,
to reduce to dust or powder, pulverize, pound, grind,
beat to pieces, bruise, smash.
—चूर्णी-कृत, अस्, आ,
अम्, pulverized, ground.

चूर्णी-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, -भवितुम्, to be-
come dust or powder, fly off into minute particles.
—चूर्णी-भवत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, becoming dust or
pulverized, crumbling.
चूर्ति चूर्ति, इस्, f. (fr. rt. चर्), going.
